page-structure.evidence: No <main> landmark (axe landmark-one-main; hasMain:false). Two unlabeled <nav> elements share the same role with no label (axe landmark-unique). Page title is descriptive (NOT REPRODUCED for 2.4.2). Heading tree: 35 headings — 33 are <h5> inside fly-out nav menus, 2 are <h3> ('Loved by us, picked for you', 'Shop clearance now'); no h1, h2, or h4 anywhere. The h3→h5 hierarchy (skipping h4 entirely) and absence of an h1 are flagged by axe page-has-heading-one (best-practice) and heading-order. One empty <h5> heading present (1.3.1 / 2.4.6). Page main content (hero, product carousels) is fully outside any landmark region (axe region: 39 nodes outside landmarks).

grouping-and-reading-order.evidence: 172 <ul>/<ol> elements have list-style:none with no explicit role='list'. In Safari + VoiceOver these lose list semantics entirely (WebKit behaviour). Chrome AX still reports list role so our driver sees them as lists, but the risk for real AT users is significant. Tab walk order (promotional banner links → header logo → search → account buttons → main nav → main content → footer) is broadly left-to-right / top-to-bottom; no major sequence inversion found. AriaHidden slideshow cells contain focusable links (axe aria-hidden-focus, 4 nodes), which places ghost tab stops inside aria-hidden containers — those items are both off-sequence and invisible to AT.

reflow.evidence: scrollWidth 320 = clientWidth 320; ratio 1.0. Page fully reflows to a single column at 320px; bodyLen 7763 (content present). 1.4.10 NOT REPRODUCED.

issues.evidence: No <main> landmark (axe landmark-one-main). Two unlabeled <nav> elements (axe landmark-unique). One empty <h5> heading. All 33 nav headings are h5 with no h1/h2/h3/h4 hierarchy; page content headings jump from h3 to h5 with no h4. 39 nodes outside any landmark region (axe region).

172 <ul>/<ol> with list-style:none and no explicit role='list'. VoiceOver/Safari strips list semantics from these — significant AT risk. 4 aria-hidden slideshow containers contain focusable links (axe aria-hidden-focus).

Product image link axName includes nested wishlist button text 'Add to default list', creating a compound name that mismatches the visible link label. Same pattern affects EL2 (Loafers) and at least 12 product card links per axe label-content-name-mismatch rule.
Same label-content-name-mismatch pattern as EL1 — product image link axName polluted with nested 'Add to default list' button text.

Non-native <div> with role:link reached by Tab but does not respond to Enter or Space (respondedToEnter:false, respondedToSpace:false). Product info cards throughout the page use this non-native interactive pattern.

computedOutline:none, computedBoxShadow:none for non-native product info div. Off-screen so no real-tab-diff, but computed styles and nearby localTabWalk stops (outlineOrShadow:false for adjacent product divs) indicate no focus ring on these non-native link elements.

Gift Registry dialog opens and focus moves in correctly, but Escape does not close the dialog (closedByEscapeOrButton:false) and focus does not return to the trigger button after interaction (focusReturnedToTrigger:false). 2.4.3 Focus Order failure.

7 links with no discernible text (axe link-name, serious). These include promotional banner links (<a href='...sale...'>) and carousel links with only image content and no alt text on their child images.
